import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class e1542easy {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner s = new Scanner(System.in);
        solve(s.nextInt(), s.nextInt());
    }

    public static void solve(int n, int mod) {
        ArrayList<int[]> inversions = buildInversions(n, mod);

        int perms[] = new int[n];
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int c = (perms[i - 1] * i) % mod;
            int inv[] = inversions.get(i - 1);
            int j = 0;
            while (j < inv.length) {
                int k = j + 2;
                while (k < inv.length) {
                    c = addTerm(c, inv[j], inv[k], i, j, k, mod);
                    k++;
                }
                j++;
            }
            perms[i] = c;
        }

        System.out.println(perms[n - 1]);
    }

    private static ArrayList<int[]> buildInversions(int n, int mod) {
        ArrayList<int[]> inversions = new ArrayList<>();
        inversions.add(new int[]{1});

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int last[] = inversions.get(i - 1);
            int next[] = new int[i * (i + 1) / 2 + 1];

            int j = 0;
            while (j < next.length) {
                int e = 0;
                int k = Math.min(j, i);
                while (k >= 0) {
                    if (j - k < last.length) {
                        e += last[j - k];
                        e = e % mod;
                    }
                    k--;
                }
                next[j] = e;
                j++;
            }
            inversions.add(next);
        }
        return inversions;
    }

    private static int addTerm(int c, int a, int b, int i, int j, int k, int mod) {
        return (c + a * b * (k - j - 1) * (2 * i - (k - j - 2)) / 2) % mod;
    }
}

    public static void solve(int n, int mod) {
        ArrayList<int[]> inversions = new ArrayList<>();
        inversions.add(new int[]{1});

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            final int[] last = inversions.get(i - 1);
            final int size = i;
            final int modulus = mod;
            int[] next = new int[size * (size + 1) / 2 + 1];

            Arrays.setAll(next, j -> computeInversionCell(last, size, j, modulus));
            inversions.add(next);
        }

        int perms[] = new int[n];
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int c = (perms[i - 1] * i) % mod;
            int inv[] = inversions.get(i - 1);
            for (int j = 0; j < inv.length; j++) {
                for (int k = j + 2; k < inv.length; k++) {
                    c = (c + inv[j] * inv[k] * (k - j - 1) * (2 * i - (k - j - 2)) / 2) % mod;
                }
            }
            perms[i] = c;
        }

        System.out.println(perms[n - 1]);
    }

    private static int computeInversionCell(int[] last, int i, int j, int mod) {
        int e = 0;
        for (int k = Math.min(j, i); k >= 0; k--) {
            if (j - k < last.length) {
                e += last[j - k];
                e = e % mod;
            }
        }
        return e;
    }

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.stream.IntStream;

public class e1542easy {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner s = new Scanner(System.in);
        solve(s.nextInt(), s.nextInt());
    }

    public static void solve(int n, int mod) {
        ArrayList<int[]> inversions = new ArrayList<>();
        inversions.add(new int[]{1});

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int[] last = inversions.get(i - 1);
            int[] next = new int[i * (i + 1) / 2 + 1];
            final int[] prev = last;
            final int row = i;

            IntStream.range(0, next.length).forEachOrdered(j -> {
                AtomicInteger e = new AtomicInteger(0);
                int kmax = Math.min(j, row);
                IntStream.iterate(kmax, k -> k - 1).limit((long) kmax + 1).forEachOrdered(k -> {
                    if (j - k < prev.length) {
                        e.set((e.get() + prev[j - k]) % mod);
                    }
                });
                next[j] = e.get();
            });

            inversions.add(next);
        }

        int perms[] = new int[n];
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            AtomicInteger c = new AtomicInteger((perms[i - 1] * i) % mod);
            int[] inv = inversions.get(i - 1);
            final int[] invLocal = inv;
            final int row = i;

            IntStream.range(0, invLocal.length).forEachOrdered(j -> {
                IntStream.range(j + 2, invLocal.length).forEachOrdered(k -> {
                    c.set((c.get() + invLocal[j] * invLocal[k] * (k - j - 1) * (2 * row - (k - j - 2)) / 2) % mod);
                });
            });

            perms[i] = c.get();
        }

        System.out.println(perms[n - 1]);
    }
}
